ti.title: ካባኻ እሞ ናበይ
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
ካብ ጉድጓድ ናይ ጥፍኣት ዘስጥም ታኼላ
ብጥበብ ተውጽኣኒ ካብቲ ጽዩፍ ናብራ
ኣምላኸይ ጸጋኻ ነዓይ ዓቢይ እዩ
ክገልጾ ዘይክእል ተኣምር ስራሕ’ዩ
[[/chorus]]

ካባኻ እሞ ናበይ ጐይታይ ካብ ጽኑዕ ፍቕርኻ
ፈልፋሊ ዛራ ሕይወተይ ዕረፍቲ ነፍሰይ ኢኻ
ሃልየ ምሳኻ ምሳኻ’ውን ሞተይ መጸናንዕየይ ካባኻ’ሞ ናበይ

ጐይታይ ካብ መንፈስካ ናበየ ክሃድም
ካብቲ ብርሃን ገጽካ ክኽወል ኣይክእልን
ንመዓሙቕ ልበይ ባዕልኻ ትምርምሮ
ቃል ከየተንባህኩ ሓሳበይ ትፈልጦ

ንዓኻ ስዒበ ፈጺመ ኣይሓፍርን
ሕይወተይ ካባኻ ክፈልያ ኣይክእልን
ኢድካ ትጓስየኒ በጊዕካ’የ ኣነ
ኣብ ደምበ ጉስነትካ ማሚቐ ሓዲረ

ti_ro.title: Kabakha 'mo nabey
ti_ro.lyrics:
Kabakha mo nabey goytay kab tsnu fqrkha
Felfali zara hywetey refti nefsey ikha
Halye msakha msakha’wn motey metsenanyey kabakha’mo nabey
Kab gudgwad nay tfat zestm takhela
Btbeb tewtsani kabti tsyuf nabra
Amlakhey tsegakha neay abiy yu
Kgeltso zeykl teamr srah’yu
Goytay kab menfeska nabeye khadm
Kabti brhan getska kkhwel aykln
Nmeamuq lbey balkha tmrmro
Qal keyetenbahku hasabey tfelto
Semay ntedeyebku abu ttsenhani
Ab mentsef nay siol idka trekhbeni
Kabakha fetsime kkhwel aykln
Msakha meritse hywet kestemaqr
Nakha sibe fetsime ayhafrn
Hywetey kabakha kfelya aykln
Idka tgwasyeni begika’ye ane
Ab dembe gusnetka mamiqe hadire
Tesfay ikha nay gulbetey brteay
Hayli tkhoneni ll zebl kewhay
Brhan nmengedey mebrahti nagarey
Amlakhey nskha derazi nbatey
